protocol: Exploratory comparisons on inspected crowd footage. Same 110-channel combined TCN dimensions, source-grouped folds, seeds, training budget, GPU and validation-only selection. Detection-only removes coordinates, body velocities and six interaction kinematic channels; confidence, joint validity, observation masks, neighbor counts and explicit coverage remain. Time-shuffling permutes already-derived feature/mask slices consistently per clip: velocity vectors remain available. It tests ordering, not removal of all motion. Fold/seed SD and paired changes are descriptive, not significance tests. No independent label review or RWF claim is made.
